PM Modi targets Congress in Odisha over ‘privileged’ loans; recalls former PM’s ‘15 paise’ remark

candidate_claims.text: Advertisment Odisha News PM Modi targets Congress in Odisha over ‘privileged’ loans; recalls former PM’s ‘15 paise’ remark PM Modi targeted Congress in Odisha over alleged “phone banking” and privileged loans, while recalling a former Prime Minister’s “15 paise” remark to contrast the previous system with the present DBT mechanism.

Suranjan Mishra 25 Oct 2026 19:59 IST File photo of Prime Minister Narendra Modi Photograph: (OTV (File)) Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Sunday launched a sharp attack on Congress over its handling of the banking system, alleging that the party-led governments had earlier allowed a “phone banking” culture in which influential people and those connected to them could secure loans worth thousands of crores.

Advertisment Also Read: ‘No one should be left behind in development journey’: PM Modi in Bhubaneswar Speaking after inaugurating an RBI data centre and a cyber security establishment at Jatni’s Infovalley-2 in Odisha, PM Modi said the country’s banking system had suffered from mismanagement under the previous Congress-led governments.

Advertisment Many Remained Outside Formal Banking System Until 2014: Modi Modi alleged that while bank nationalisation in the 1960s and 1970s was carried out in the name of the poor, a large section of the population remained outside the formal banking ecosystem until 2014.

Targeting a former Congress Prime Minister and without directly taking anyone’s name, Modi recalled the leader’s admission that out of every Re 1 sent from New Delhi, only 15 paise reached the people (beneficiaries).
